title: Chapter 84 Fraud And Fraud
content:
Chapter 84 Fraud And Fraud

Just when everyone was still shocked by Patriarch Jones, this bold and very unimaginable tactic, Patriarch Jones once again revealed his follow-up plan.

"When the time comes, we will contact the small clan leaders that we can trust, and we will agree to kill those stubborn people who are loyal to Boris when the enemy's army is under the city, lead all the troops to surrender the city, and kill them together from the south to Cleland. City, Boris would never have imagined that I would betray at this moment, I really look forward to the moment when our troops are under the city, how wonderful his face will be!"

At this moment, Patriarch Jones is already fantasizing about the moment when he will get revenge. What kind of experience is it? A grim expression appeared on his face.

There is no difference between men and women when it comes to revenge. And after a lot of planning and hard work, after a successful revenge, the experience is more vivid than any pleasure.

And because of this kind of revenge, things are often shocking to other people who usually know themselves.

That's how it is at the moment. Patriarch Jones, who was usually very brave and upright, chose to deceive and betray because of his revenge mentality, which made the elders and leaders who usually thought they had seen through this patriarch, a chill in their hearts. , terrified.

Just like Wu Zixu in ancient China, before his father and family were ordered to be executed by the King of Chu, this man was an upright and promising young man who was full of yearning for the future.

However, after being killed by the king of Chu, he immediately fled to the state of Wu, used everything he had to help the state of Wu become strong, and led the army of the state of Wu to almost destroy the state of Chu.

After breaking the capital of the state of Chu, he found that his enemy, the King of Chu, had been dead for a long time, and the anger in his heart could not be released, so he dug up all the corpses and whipped them to vent his anger.

This is enough to prove that because of anger, a person can disregard the interests of the country and moral constraints, and only hope that his inner resentment can be extended and expressed.

In this way, under the proposal of Patriarch Jones, this decision, which can not only ensure the survival of the tribe, but also take revenge on his archenemy, the Creland tribe, has been approved by all the elders and leaders.

The whole tribe turned as fast as a machine, and the messengers set out to the small tribes with the orders of Patriarch Jones.

For a time, the entire plain was filled with fast-running barbarian warriors. There is no way, the Ansen Tribe is not as rich as the Creeland Tribe, and all the red fire beasts can only guarantee the standard of the patriarch and the elder leaders.

As for those lowly tribal warriors, they can only rely on their own legs to deliver letters. The powerful red fire beasts can only be enjoyed by nobles such as noble tribal elders and patriarchs.

These lowly tribal people are considered a great crime to touch them at ordinary times. They are considered by all tribal high-level officials to blaspheme the honor of being a noble, which should be punished by capital punishment.

Among the complaints of the messengers, one by one the passwords were conveyed to the various small tribes. Under the double suppression of the Creeland tribe and the Anson tribe, all the small tribes did not dare to disobey their orders.

Only the resigned warriors from their own tribe went there. The Ansen tribe's camp gathered together and prepared to welcome the army of 50,000 people.

For a time, the Ansen tribe in the southern part of the entire northern region, together with the eleven small tribes under its jurisdiction. Being mobilized everywhere, warriors were recruited and incorporated into the army of the tribe.

The entire Ansen tribe, 5,000 people of the whole clan were all mobilized, and a total of 1,600 troops who could use weapons to fight were mobilized.

As for the other small tribes, either one hundred and fifty, or two hundred, under the persecution of the Anson tribe in the name of the Creland tribe.

All the adult males of the entire group were pulled out, and only a few old and weak women and children were left in the tribe to guard, and the defense force was extremely weak.

For a time, the small tribes in the south were full of complaints, and they were full of anger and dare not speak against the Creeland and Anson tribes.

However, although the small tribe was full of complaints, Patriarch Jones also achieved his goal. A total of 1,400 warriors were summoned into his camp and formed an army of 3,000 people with his tribe's headquarters.

This is the capital he uses to make ends meet between the Creeland tribe and the army in the south. It is not sloppy at all, as long as the goal can be achieved, what is the complaint of those small tribes!

However, before that, he still needs to train the army and strengthen his control over him. At that time, it will be much easier if he wants to win the rights of the patriarchs who are interested in the Creland tribe.

The sound of military drills was heard far away. In the entire northern region, so many troops will not be gathered in two or three years, but they are training day and night in the large tribe of 5,000 people in the south, the Ansen tribe.

You must know that if so many troops are usually called, they are all under the leadership of Patriarch Boris of the Creeland tribe to resist the southern invasion of the northern kingdom of Ryan, or to support the predicament of the alliance leader. How big is the army?

Now, in a small tribe with less than 10,000 people, such a large army has gathered. If people who don't know it know it, they will definitely be envious for a while, thinking that this small tribe has the potential to become a big tribe, and is accumulating prestige and summoning other tribes to merge into their own tribe.

But the previous people didn't think so, instead they would show a sneer in their hearts, gloatingly looking forward to the next fate of the Ansen tribe.

You must know that his 3,000 troops are used to fight against 50,000 troops that are nearly twenty times his size! Under the threat of this kind of enemy, it seems that any glory becomes irrelevant, at least the life may not be his own.

The current Clyland tribe patriarch, Boris thought so, and he also summoned the elders in his tribe to laugh at the Jones patriarch who is still playing a role in the south.

Looking at him in the last days before his death, he tried his best to gather all the troops, gather all the forces that could be gathered, and struggled to get a chance to survive in this vortex.

Anyway, Boris is not worried about his next path. At this time, the messenger has already rode the red fire beast and quickly went to the southern guard general of the Ryan Kingdom, General Andrew, to discuss the next cooperation.

If it can be negotiated, then General Andrew will lead his army of 5,000 people to the south to his own Creeland, where he has assisted him, and together resist the attack of the southern army.

And next, he will ask for help from the imperial city of the Kingdom of Ryan, and a steady stream of troops will begin to descend. In order to appease its northern region, the Orion Kingdom will inevitably guarantee its position and allow itself to continue to rule the north.

In this way, he doesn't seem to have any losses, but maybe his tribe will lose some warriors, but what does it matter?

These untouchables are like weeds. A batch of them died today and will continue to grow tomorrow. As long as they are still the patriarch, they can sacrifice everything.
